# What an observation changes

In the workshop I stand beside the sign-in book, and people tell me why they are late. When I sit at the bench they show me what broke. My position changes the conversation before I ask a question. [[Field methods]] should include where I stood, not only what I wrote down. There may be no invisible observer, but there can be a better-described one.
